subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - FinovateBank procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@finovatebank.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - FinovateBank procurement

Hi Jordan / Priya - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

Call recap:
- Use case: FinovateBank is evaluating Redwood to power customer support summarization and secure embeddings for internal search.
- Decision drivers: latency under 300ms for conversational flows, SOC2 evidence + encryption at-rest, predictable pricing for ~10M tokens/month.
- Proposed pilot: 3-week scoped pilot with a dedicated endpoint and monitoring.

Stakeholder mapping (as we understood it):
- Economic buyer: Amit Desai (VP Finance) - budget holder / final sign-off
- Procurement: Priya Shah - contract + procurement questionnaire owner
- Security/legal: Security team (you mentioned Suresh and Anika) - will want SOC2 + network diagrams
- Champion: Jordan (product) - internal advocate and day-to-day contact

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Priya - can you confirm the procurement questionnaire owner and desired timeline? We filled the questionnaire with our answers and attached it here for your review.
2) Jordan - is Amit available for a brief (15-20m) ROI/finance walkthrough next week? I can tailor a short slide showing cost savings estimates.
3) Security - we have SOC2 Type II evidence and a network diagram; happy to schedule a 30m call for your security team.

Attachments included: FinovateBank-procurement-questionnaire-answered.docx (our answers), RB-RUNTIME-ROI-1pager.pdf (high-level ROI/talk tracks), SOC2-type2-evidence.zip (redacted artifacts).

Proposed mutual action plan:
- 2/19: Pilot kickoff (technical onboarding)
- 2/23: Security questionnaire review with your security team
- 2/26: Finance/ROI call with Amit (if available)
- 3/12: Pilot wrap + procurement decision

Please let me know if those dates look reasonable or suggest alternatives. Happy to loop in Solutions/Legal as needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa - solid recap, appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers: 

- Procurement owner: Priya (cc'd) will own the questionnaire and contract. She prefers to review completed drafts first, then loop legal.
- Security contacts: Suresh Raj (suresh.raj@finovatebank.com) and Anika Verma (anika.verma@finovatebank.com). They typically want a 30-45m walkthrough and the SOC2 artifacts.
- Timeline: target procurement approval by 3/12 is realistic but depends on SOC/Legal. If we can get SOC2 evidence + a short network diagram this week, we can accelerate.
- Budget: Amit is the economic buyer. He asked for a back-of-envelope for 10M tokens/mo - could you share a pricing estimate and expected monthly run-rate impact?

Also cc'ing Priya so she can confirm internal procurement steps and provide any extra docs they need from vendors.

Jordan
Senior Product Manager, Search & Insights
FinovateBank

Thanks Jordan / Priya - attaching the PSOA/DPA templates and a short ROI 1-pager. For Amit, I prepared a 5-slide finance-friendly talk track we can use on a 15-20m call:

Key ROI points (for the finance call):
- Expected token usage: 10M tokens/month (conservative estimate based on your pilot scope).
- Cost levers: batching + prefix caching should reduce token burn by ~20-30% for transcripts; we estimate $Xk/month net after batching for the pilot configuration (see attached ROI doc).
- Operational savings: reduced average handle time (AHT) for support summarization - projected 15% FTE-equivalent savings for triage team.

Champion enablement / talk tracks (for Jordan):
- Product angle: improve search relevance and summarize conversations to speed agent resolution.
- Security angle: SOC2, encryption, and VPC options - ready to demo the audit logs.
- Procurement angle: predictable monthly pricing and committed capacity option for Dedicated offering.

Attachments included: PSOA-sample.pdf, DPA-template.pdf, RB-RUNTIME-ROI-1pager.pdf (attached earlier).

Next steps I propose:
- 2/20: Security walkthrough (30m) with Suresh + Anika - Rachel will join to cover audit logs.
- 2/23: Pricing and pilot configuration note to Amit + Priya - I'll send a brief finance slide deck.
- 2/26: ROI call with Amit (15-20m) - please confirm availability.

HubSpot link with notes and the mutual action plan: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
Drive with supporting materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cROI

If that works, Priya - happy to accept edits to the questionnaire doc and return a redlined contract draft.

Best,
Marissa

Quick internal note - forwarding Jordan's reply below. We need a one-pager + 2-slide finance deck for Amit:

Ask:
- Rachel: can you prepare a 2-slide finance deck (ROI slide + monthly cost run-rate) using the ROI 1-pager attached earlier? Keep it short - Amit prefers a focused cost/benefit view.
- Neha: please prep a 1-page technical snapshot (SOC2 highlights, encryption, VPC options, audit logs) for the security walkthrough on 2/20.

Talking points to arm Jordan (champion):
- Short opener: "Redwood will reduce average handle time by ~15% and provide predictable per-token pricing with enterprise controls."
- Procurement: highlight committed capacity option and PSOA + DPA are available; we can accept typical procurement redlines (we'll triage legal asks).
- Security: point them to the SOC2 artifacts and mention the ability to run in their VPC for sensitive workloads.

I'll draft the quick email Jordan can forward to Amit with the finance slides. Let's aim to have materials ready by EOD 2/25.

Thanks -
Marissa
